top_signals.title: Asset Manager Australian Dollar Shorts Hit Record on Risk-Off
top_signals.summary: Asset managers’ short positions on the Australian dollar surged to a record high in the week ended Oct. 20, as mounting Middle East tensions and jitters over the artificial intelligence trade spurred a retreat from the risk-sensitive currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Stocks Under Pressure Before Earnings, Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks struggled to recover from a volatile week as investors braced for more earnings from megacap tech companies that will offer clues on whether the recent pressure on the artificial intelligence trade will persist. Treasuries rose as crude oil fell.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: UK proposes 14-year prison terms for undersea cable sabotage
top_signals.summary: In an era of hybrid threats, the British government wants to update the Submarine Telegraph Act 1885, which carries a maximum fine of £1,000 and five years’ imprisonment in cases of deliberate damage.
